def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    # Mask for bins that cannot fit the item
    cannot_fit = remaining < 0
    # Prioritize bins that fit the item, with lower remaining capacity having higher priority
    priorities = np.where(cannot_fit, -np.inf, remaining)
    # Invert the priority so smaller remaining capacity has higher score (i.e., more favorable)
    # Use negative of remaining to make smaller leftover space = higher priority
    return -priorities

    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - (bins > 0) * item  # Adjust for bins that cannot fit the item
    # Penalize bins that cannot fit the item by setting their priority to 0
    valid_bins = (remaining >= 0) & (bins > 0)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - np.fmin(bins, item)
    normalized_remaining = remaining / (bins + 1e-8)
    return normalized_remaining
